title: Thank you Kevin :D
body: I love when developers work hard on something that actually benefits peoples lives and not just hooks peoples attention for hours on end, this app has helped me so much with tracking how well I do with my bad habits and my good ones too, so thank you so much Kevin! You are a good man doing great work for our society and our people :)

title: Love it!
body:
It is so simple to use! It removes all of the complicated and bloated features other apps always insist on using. 

If you want a tracker that will feel effortless to use, then I recommend this.
